name: offload-mcp-server

tools.name: offload_submit_task
tools.description:
Hand a heavy READ-ONLY task to a background worker agent (default: agy) and get a job_id back immediately.

Use it when the work means reading a lot but the answer is small: scanning many files, filtering large logs, analyzing a big bundle or resource file, inventorying APIs/strings/config across a tree. The worker replies with a short Summary plus Findings with path:line evidence, so you read a few hundred words instead of the files.

Do NOT use it for edits, for small lookups you can do in one or two reads, or for anything security-sensitive you must verify line by line yourself. The worker is another model: treat its findings as leads and spot-check the ones you act on.

Write a complete BRIEF. The worker executes it literally and does nothing else, so anything you leave vague it will skip or guess:
- task: the goal as one concrete question.
- steps: ordered, concrete actions; each names what to open or search and what to record.
- output_hint: the exact shape of the Findings (columns, grouping, sort order, what goes in each column).
- done_when: the stop condition, so the worker neither stops early nor wanders.
- context (optional): what you already know (conventions, file roles), so the worker does not rediscover it.
- exclude (optional): files, folders or kinds of results to leave out.
The worker returns a Step log; the status tells you which steps it did not finish.

Next: call offload_get_status with the job_id and wait_sec=50 until it finishes.

Example:
task="Which HTTP endpoints does api/v1 register, and what auth does each require?"
steps=["List every .php file under api/v1 from FILES IN SCOPE.", "In each file, find each route: URL path and the HTTP methods it accepts.", "For each route, record the auth check it calls (function name), or 'none'."]
output_hint="table: url | methods | auth check | handler path:line, sorted by url"
done_when="Every file under api/v1 has been read and every route is in the table."
exclude=["api/v1/tests/"]

task.description: The goal: one concrete question the report must answer, e.g. "Which endpoints in api/v1 skip the CSRF check?"

steps.description: Ordered actions for the worker, each concrete: what to open or search, what to record. The worker performs exactly these, in order, and logs each as done/partial/not done.

output_hint.description: Exact shape of the Findings, e.g. "table: name | path:line | purpose, sorted by path".

done_when.description: Stop condition, e.g. "every file under api/v1 is read and every route is listed".

context.description: Facts you already know that save the worker time: conventions, which file does what, names to look for.

exclude.description: What to leave out: files, folders, or kinds of results, e.g. ["tests/", "commented-out code"].

paths.description: Files or folders to focus on, relative to the workspace, e.g. ["api/core", "dist/app.js"]. Empty = whole workspace.

workspace.description: Absolute workspace path. Defaults to the current project; other paths must be listed in allowedRoots.

backend.description: Backend name from the config. Available: agy.

timeout_sec.description: Kill the worker after this many seconds. Defaults to the backend's timeoutSec.

tools.name: offload_get_status
tools.description:
Get the status of one offloaded job, optionally waiting up to 50s for it to finish. When the job is done this already includes the worker's Summary, so you usually do not need offload_get_result.
Without job_id, lists the most recent jobs.

job_id.description: Job ID from offload_submit_task. Omit to list recent jobs.

wait_sec.description: Seconds to wait for completion before answering (max 50).

limit.description: How many recent jobs to list when job_id is omitted.

tools.name: offload_get_result
tools.description:
Read the worker's report for a finished job, in pages of up to 25000 characters.
part="summary" (short answer), "findings" (evidence list), "steps" (Step log: done/partial/not done per step), "uncertain", "full" (whole report), "stderr" (backend error output, for debugging a failed job).

part.description: Which part of the report to read.

offset.description: Character offset, for paging through long parts.

tools.name: offload_cancel_task
tools.description: Stop a queued or running offloaded job and its worker process tree. Finished jobs are left as they are.
